questions.question: Sami calls Mina: 'A patient wants a Hollywood ultra-white smile!' Mina answers:
options: Explain that natural is often more aesthetic
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A smile that is too white can look artificial.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll offer a more natural shade.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a patient with teeth that are too small?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Veneers can modify the shape and length of teeth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll propose veneers to lengthen the teeth.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage a patient with an asymmetrical smile?' Mina answers:
options: Orthodontic or surgical treatment may be necessary
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Asymmetry often requires a multidisciplinary approach.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll do a complete assessment.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is a gummy smile?' Mina answers:
options: A smile that shows too much gum
A smile with no visible teeth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A gummy smile may require periodontal treatment.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll propose a gingivectomy.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the golden ratio in dental aesthetics?' Mina answers:

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage worn teeth in aesthetics?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Bruxism wear must be treated before aesthetics.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll treat bruxism first.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the midline in aesthetics?' Mina answers:
options: The alignment of central incisors with the center of the face
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The midline should be aligned for a harmonious smile.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll always check the alignment.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a devitalized tooth in aesthetics?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Devitalized teeth can be internally whitened or covered with a veneer.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll propose internal whitening.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the advantages of digital planning in aesthetics?' Mina answers:
options: Precision, visualization, communication with the patient
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Digital planning offers multiple advantages.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll use digital tools.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage patients with fluorosis?' Mina answers:
options: Veneers or micro-abrasion depending on severity
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Mild fluorosis can be treated with micro-abrasion, severe cases with veneers.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll evaluate the severity of fluorosis.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is micro-abrasion in aesthetics?' Mina answers:
options: A technique to remove superficial stains
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Micro-abrasion is indicated for superficial stains.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll propose micro-abrasion.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage overbite teeth in aesthetics?' Mina answers:
options: Prior orthodontic treatment is often necessary
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Overbite often requires orthodontic correction.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll do orthodontics first.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the importance of photos in aesthetics?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Photos are essential for planning and communication.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll always take photos.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a patient with an asymmetrical smile?' Mina answers:
options: An orthodontic and periodontal assessment is necessary
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Asymmetry requires a multidisciplinary approach.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll do a complete assessment.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the advantages of a mock-up in aesthetics?' Mina answers:
options: Visualization of the final result for the patient
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The mock-up allows the patient to visualize the result.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll always do a mock-up.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage patients with dark teeth?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Whitening is the first option, veneers if necessary.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll offer whitening first.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the signs of pathological tooth wear?' Mina answers:
options: Flat occlusal surfaces, worn incisal edges, sensitivity
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Pathological wear presents with multiple signs.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll look for these signs.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage patients with tobacco-stained teeth?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Tobacco stains can often be removed by scaling and whitening.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll offer scaling first.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the tooth axis in aesthetics?' Mina answers:
options: The inclination of the tooth relative to the facial axis
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The tooth axis should be parallel to the facial axis.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll always check the axes.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage patients with teeth that are too long?' Mina answers:
options: Occlusal evaluation and orthodontic treatment if necessary
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Teeth that are too long are often related to excessive occlusion.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll do an occlusal analysis.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the importance of occlusion in aesthetics?' Mina answers:
options: Essential for the longevity of restorations
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Occlusion is crucial for the longevity of restorations.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll always check occlusion.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage patients with an asymmetrical smile?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Orthodontics is often the first step.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll do orthodontics first.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the advantages of ultra-thin veneers?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Ultra-thin veneers allow minimal preparation.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll offer ultra-thin veneers.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage patients with age-discolored teeth?' Mina answers:
options: Whitening or veneers depending on condition
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Aging can be treated with whitening or veneers.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll offer whitening first.'
